description:
This protocol automates a PCR prep involving uniquely barcoded forward primers and can accommodate 1-96 samples.

The protocol begins with the creation of a reaction mix (water, mastermix, and reverse primers) and distribution of that reaction mix. Following this, uniquely barcoded forward primers are transferred to corresponding wells of the PCR plate containing the reaction mix. Finally, samples are transferred in a similar manner from a deep well plate to the PCR plate.


If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at protocols@opentrons.com.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons 20µL Filter Tip Rack
NEST 12-Well Reservoir, 15mL
NEST 96-Well PCR Plate
KingFisher Deep Well Plate, 2mL
PlateOne Deep Well Plate, 1mL
Samples
Reagents (Water, Mastermix, Primers)



Deck Layout

Slot 1: KingFisher Deep Well Plate containing Samples

Slot 2: Opentrons 200µL Filter Tip Rack

Slot 3: Opentrons 20µL Filter Tip Rack

Slot 4: NEST 96-Well PCR Plate (clean and empty)

Slot 5: NEST 12-Well Reservoir, 15mL (for reagents)
A1: Water (26µL per sample, plus overage)
A2: Mastermix (20µL per sample, plus overage)
A3: Reverse Primers (1µL per sample, plus overage)
A4: Empty; will be used for reaction mix

Slot 6: Opentrons 20µL Filter Tip Rack

Slot 7: PlateOne Deep Well Plate containing Forward Primers
